title: How Much Further Can the Dollar Run After Last Week’s Broad Rally?
summary: The Dollar Index closed near 101.03 after a hawkish Fed-driven rally, but it’s now approaching genuine resistance at 101.80–102.86 rather than emerging from support—clearing that zone likely requires the 10-year Treasury yield, not the already-stretched 2-year, to extend further.
